description: Fixtures 01 and 04 rebuilt for an STM32F1-like board (flash at 0x08000000, 128K RAM, USART1 at 0x40013800 with RXNE=bit5/TXE=bit7). The profile only names an SVD file: memory map and vector table must be derived from the ELF, and the UART model from the SVD.

cases.reason: Fixture 01's overflow at the STM32 layout.
Fixture 04's UART-fed overflow; needs the SVD's USART1 model to deliver input.
